transcript: Speaker A: I've been sending texts at the gym for the last six months. The last thing I want to do at the gym when I walk in is send a text message. This app allows you to just tap and talk. Log a set, text a gym bro, do everything four times faster. Perfect for gym goers, athletes, even Pilates girlies. Give it a try and download Whisper Flow for free today.
on_screen_text:
The gym app you didn't know you needed
4x faster than typing
Whisper Flow
summary: A gym-goer demonstrates how typing texts during workouts is inconvenient and introduces Whisper Flow, a voice-to-text app that is four times faster than typing. He showcases its ease of use during exercises and invites viewers to download it for free.
